methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UNCCD's resource catalog is a Drupal-based, server-rendered listing. Resource cards, facets and numbered pagination are all present in the initial HTML, making the catalog scrapable without a browser engine.

## Search
The listing supports Drupal Search-API full-text filtering via a query parameter (search_api_fulltext={query}) appended to the all-resources URL. Faceted filtering by resource type is also available.

## Filters
Resource type facets (global-land-outlook, brief, other, etc.) appear as URL segments/params. No published filter schema, so facets are treated as opaque URL parameters.

## Download
Each resource card links to a record page at /resources/{resource-type}/{slug}. The PDF download is exposed on that record page rather than in the listing, so a two-step crawl is needed.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Title, resource type and publication date are present in the server-rendered HTML. No JSON/REST API is exposed, so enrichment relies on HTML parsing of record pages.

## Limitations
No public repository API. Pagination uses ?page=N. Content is behind a CDN; send a realistic User-Agent. PDF links must be resolved per-record.
